summary: Defines BUNDLE, an SDP grouping extension that lets several media streams, such as audio and video, share a single transport port pair instead of using one each. This reduces the number of network resources and NAT bindings needed. It is standards-track and was replaced by RFC 9143.

eli5.summary: Instead of sending each toy in its own separate box, you pack many toys into one big box and send it once. That saves effort and fewer doors need to be opened. This version was replaced by RFC 9143.

questions: how to send audio and video over one port
